title: SCDM: Scalable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Temporal Systems with Meta-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal discovery from nonlinear multivariate time series is challenging in high-dimensional systems, where the number of candidate directed relations grows quadratically with the number of variables. Existing methods are often limited by target-wise model fitting, repeated conditional testing, or expensive graph-search procedures. We propose SCDM, a shared-parameter meta-learning framework for scalable temporal causal discovery. SCDM treats each target variable as a task while learning a shared temporal predictor and a shared causal-strength matrix across tasks. Each meta-episode updates only a subset of target-variable tasks, allowing the model to accumulate structural evidence across the full system without exhaustive target-wise optimization. translated_title: SCDM：基于元学习的非线性时序系统可扩展因果发现
translated_abstract: 从非线性多元时间序列中进行因果发现在高维系统中极具挑战性，因为候选有向关系的数量随变量数量呈二次增长。现有方法往往受限于逐目标变量的模型拟合、重复的条件独立性检验或昂贵的图搜索过程。我们提出了SCDM，一个用于可扩展时序因果发现的共享参数元学习框架。SCDM将每个目标变量视为一个任务，同时跨任务学习一个共享的时序预测器和一个共享的因果强度矩阵。每个元学习回合仅更新目标变量任务的一个子集，使模型能够在整个系统中积累结构证据，而无需进行穷举式的逐目标优化。训练完成后，训练后图读取步骤将学习到的预测器转换为连续的有向因果分数，以实现与阈值无关的评估。我们还提供了有限误差下的结构恢复保证（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出SCDM框架，通过元学习将每个目标变量作为任务并共享时序预测器与因果强度矩阵，避免了穷举式逐目标优化，从而实现高维非线性时序系统的可扩展因果发现。
en_tdlr: SCDM is a shared-parameter meta-learning framework that treats each target variable as a task while learning a shared temporal predictor and causal-strength matrix, enabling scalable causal discovery in high-dimensional nonlinear temporal systems without exhaustive target-wise optimization.
